about.title: Lathrop Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Lathrop's location along I-5, near SR-120, Harlan Road, and E Louise Avenue means steady traffic through town — and San Joaquin County's public crash records show that in the most recent reporting year, two of those collisions ended in a life lost. Behind each number is a family trying to make sense of a sudden absence: a spouse planning a funeral instead of dinner, children asking questions no parent should have to answer alone. California law gives certain surviving family members a path to hold a negligent driver or party accountable through a civil wrongful death claim, separate from anything that happens in criminal court. That claim can address funeral and burial costs, the financial support your family has lost, and the loss of companionship and guidance that no amount of money truly replaces — but pursuing it means facing deadlines and legal standing rules while you're still grieving. LawProactive connects Lathrop families with an independent, contingency-fee attorney who can carry that weight so you don't have to do it alone.

whyChoose.title: Why Lathrop Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Strict
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim — typically a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible only in certain situations. An attorney can help sort out who qualifies before that window narrows further.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. Given how many Lathrop collisions happen near county and state roads like SR-120 and I-5, confirming which deadline applies matters early.

items.title: No Upfront Cost to Your Family
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for your family. That means one less financial burden while you're already carrying so much.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing under certain circumstances. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm who is eligible to bring the claim.

items.question: Does a wrongful death claim depend on a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No — a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, even if the same crash leads to criminal charges. The civil case can move forward on its own timeline and doesn't require a criminal conviction to proceed. This matters for Lathrop families since criminal proceedings often take far longer than civil deadlines allow.

items.question: Our loved one died in a crash near I-5 or SR-120 in Lathrop. What can we recover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery of funeral and burial costs, the financial support your family has lost, and compensation for the loss of companionship, love, and guidance. Every family's losses look different, so an attorney will look at your specific circumstances rather than apply a one-size answer. Whether the crash occurred on a state highway or a local Lathrop road can also affect which deadlines and parties are involved.
